script.narration: Mars slowly destroys your physical body. A six-month journey gets you there. But space travel has strict limits. No human has surpassed 437 days. The thin atmosphere offers no protection. It is only one percent thick. Radiation hits you like daily X-rays. You absorb 0.67 millisieverts every day. Five meters of soil must cover you. This shields you from cosmic rays. Cancer risks rise by ten percent. Mars gravity is only 38 percent. This low gravity weakens your heart. Your bones lose one percent monthly. Toxic perchlorates contaminate the drinking water. Thyroid function drops from tiny amounts. Radio signals take twenty-four minutes. Help is too far away.
